actual_cycles.scope: Every actual source and all eleven raw fixtures are replayed. On each distinct normalized cycle, all alignment offsets modulo the only possible primitive base length m/gcd(A,m) are tested; shifts by a whole base block merely rotate the phase sequence. Nonmembers remain valid cycles and are not excluded.

clock: Positive raw odd-only cycles, with separately expanded shortcut clocks for the high family; state1 is not absorbed.

high_family.scope: Twenty finite examples of the written all-prime family. Every displayed six-block word is primitive; odd-only period6m and shortcut period6A are distinguished. Local minima are counted on the actual expanded shortcut cycle. Every full row including all odd states enters the verification digest; only the smallest case stores its full state array, and every case stores the reconstructible word, numerator, denominator and state digests. No literature comparison follows from the counts alone.

phase_grid.scope: Exhaustive displayed phase words in this finite grid, including repeated whole words. Rotations and powers are counted explicitly and do not represent additional primitive cycles.

scope: One primitive positive mechanical base, all blocks rotations of that same base. Different base totals or arbitrary nonmechanical blocks are outside this theorem. Repetitions reduce to their primitive word. The base(2) gives denominator1 and must survive. The written q1 spread<8 rigidity step is not proved by this script.
status: Exact finite checks of the written arbitrary-concatenation theorem; no universal inference from the census alone.
